recipe.name: Ham and Cheese Egg Bites

yield.pan: two 12-cup silicone muffin tins, baked one at a time

wet.note: A standard 1 lb container. Or 2 cups plain Greek yogurt - macros essentially identical at 2%.

dry.note: About 6 oz - 3/4 of an 8 oz bag. Any good melting cheese works: cheddar, Monterey Jack, Colby Jack, or a cheddar jack blend
Drop to 1/4 tsp if your ham is salty

foldIns.note: Total for the batch - about 4 oz per tin. Optional: dry-saute 2-3 min first.

steps: Preheat oven to 300F. Optional: set a baking dish of hot water on the bottom rack for steam.
Dice the ham small. Divide evenly among the wells of tin 1.
Blend eggs, cottage cheese, shredded cheese, cornstarch, salt, and pepper 45 seconds until completely smooth.
Pour the egg mix over the ham, leaving a little room at the top.
Bake tin 1 for 25 minutes, until centers are just set and an instant-read thermometer reads 160F.
Rest 5-10 minutes, then pop the bites out and cool on a rack.
Fill tin 2 the same way and bake 25 minutes.
recipe.storage: Fridge up to 4 days in an airtight container. Freeze up to 2 months - cool completely first.
recipe.reheat: From fridge: oven 300F, covered, 8-10 min until 165F. From frozen: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat as above.

macrosPerBite.notes: Based on 2% cottage cheese and cheddar jack. 3 bites = ~270 cal, ~27g protein.

recipe.notes: Silicone tins release without greasing in this kitchen - no water bath and no stirring between rounds needed either. Empty wells need no water. 1 1/2 cups cheese, not the whole 8 oz bag; save the rest.
